pilot.review_source: live T1 + T2 review_end events only; calibration reviews not pooled (PLAN-v4.1 6.2-6.3)

alpha_beta_descriptive.note: descriptive only (PLAN-v3 section 7); three sizes cannot identify alpha and beta.

operating_characteristics.source: OPERATING-CHARACTERISTICS.md, design-search/oc_v41.py, 2000 simulated studies per cell

outcomes.statement: Primary quantitative test: finished at N = 12 lies inside Carnot's 95% predictive interval, (1 - b) x V x hours with V and b from the pilot
outcomes.rule: PASS if the N = 12 windows' total finished count is in the pooled 95% predictive interval (Poisson-gamma, CV 0.3 per window)
outcomes.note: observed 43, predicted 35.5 (20-54); simulated false-alarm rate under Carnot truth 0.10 at review-time CV 1, 0.04 at 0.5

outcomes.statement: O2 without the N = 12 windows that ran out of tasks before minute 110 (reported beside O2)
outcomes.rule: as O2, on the unflagged windows only
outcomes.note: no window flagged: identical to O2

outcomes.statement: Manipulation check: the harness's fixed-capacity reviewer caps output (Carnot's review-capped prediction has a higher likelihood than the best uncapped rival: USL, Amdahl, linear)
outcomes.rule: PASS if log L(Carnot) > max log L(USL, Amdahl, linear), `completion` reading, NB CV 0.3
outcomes.note: best uncapped rival: USL, no review limit; log LR (Carnot - best uncapped) = +1.40, LR = 4.04. Simulated: correct 0.97 under Carnot truth, 0.80 / 1.00 / 1.00 under USL / Amdahl / linear. Manipulation check: the harness's fixed-capacity reviewer is the binding limit by design, so a FAIL indicates a harness or calibration fault, not support for an uncapped rival. The P1 rates under USL, Amdahl and linear truth come from a synthetic reviewer that speeds up with queue depth (synth.py, reviewer_load = 2); the real harness cannot produce such a reviewer (a fresh call per change that never sees the queue), so those rows describe a counterfactual, not a result the study can observe.

outcomes.statement: P1 without the windows that ran out of tasks before minute 110 (reported beside P1)
outcomes.rule: as P1, on the unflagged windows only
outcomes.note: no window flagged: identical to P1

outcomes.statement: The reviewer's pace does not change with load (Welch t-test on log review durations, N = 12 vs N = 1)
outcomes.rule: FAIL iff two-sided p < 0.05, else PASS; no equivalence claim
outcomes.note: geometric-mean duration ratio 0.76, p = 0.234, n = 45 / 83; simulated power vs a +/-25% reviewer 0.73 at review-time CV 0.5, 0.18 at CV 1; review_cv_ok = false in pilot.json: descriptive

outcomes.statement: The review-bounce share b_review does not rise with fleet size
outcomes.rule: FAIL if b_review(high) > b_review(low) at one-sided Fisher exact p < 0.05 (review bounces / reviews, pooled per size); other bounce causes reported separately (BOUNCE)

outcomes.statement: Attempts rise with fleet size (fleet first-attempt rate)
outcomes.rule: PASS if the high/low first-attempt rate ratio > 1 at one-sided exact p < 0.05; FAIL if < 1 at p < 0.05; else INCONCLUSIVE

outcomes.statement: V(N = 12) / V(N = 1) with its exact 95% interval (no equivalence claim)
Surprise: finished ratio >= 1.3 x Carnot's predicted ratio with the queue non-empty
outcomes.rule: FAIL if (observed / predicted ratio) >= 1.3 and queue non-empty >= 50% of the N_high windows
outcomes.note: observed ratio 2.26 vs Carnot-predicted 1.87; queue non-empty 94% of the N = 12 windows; false-alarm rate under Carnot 0.05

outcomes.statement: Surprise: finished ratio <= 0.7 x Carnot's predicted ratio (not a criterion)
outcomes.rule: FAIL if (observed / predicted ratio) <= 0.7 and queue non-empty >= 50% of the N_high windows
outcomes.note: observed ratio 2.26 vs Carnot-predicted 1.87; queue non-empty 94% of the N = 12 windows; fires 0.53 of the time under Carnot's own truth, so it is not a criterion

outcomes.statement: Four-way ranking of the rivals (USL vs Amdahl is not claimed)
outcomes.rule: reported with the simulated confusion matrix
outcomes.note: highest likelihood: Carnot, review-capped; order carnot > usl > amdahl > linear

outcomes.statement: Escaped defects vs reviewer queue depth
outcomes.rule: `logit_cluster_task`, window FE, task-clustered; modelled only with >= 8 events
outcomes.note: OR per waiting change 0.90, one-sided p = 0.947; simulated power 0.12 (a null result is not evidence)

outcomes.statement: Collisions: bounced at least once vs changes in flight (k) and file overlap (m)
outcomes.rule: logistic with window FE, censored first attempts excluded; p-hat in the model form
outcomes.note: k OR 0.887 (one-sided p 0.971); p-hat 0.0000; simulated k-slope power 0.08 at p = 0.01, 0.36 at p = 0.05

outcomes.statement: Bounce causes other than review (rebase conflict, visible fail, escaped defect, integration failure) per approval with a merge-queue result
outcomes.rule: reported by size; not a criterion
